rationale: The raw filing contains separate March 31, 2025 and December 31, 2024 schedule-of-investments sections. The flagged PP03 rows are reported as retained comparative-period facts under report_date 2025-03-31. The cited December 31, 2024 schedule heading and flagged rows show that prior-period SOI rows were available to leak into the current-period holdings extraction; current-period holdings should not retain rows whose source period is earlier than the report date.
